messages.author: 428d1e2fc2be88d9
messages.subject: Trajectory Analysis layout configuration
parts:
Dear all, 

Currently I am working on assessing morphological diversification of the vertebral column and individual vertebrae in salamandrids. To visualize relative shape changes between complete vertebral columns and individual vertebrae, I decided to plot these as trajectories in a phenotypic trajectory analysis. I managed to perform the analysis, however I am wondering how/if I could change the principle components? I am interested in plotting PC1 vs PC3. Also, is it possible to generate a plot without the legend? 

Best regards, 

Stefan

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Trajectory Analysis layout configuration
parts:
Stefan,

The objects, $pc.means, $pc.data, and $pc.trajectories returned from a class trajectory.analysis object will allow you to make any kind of plots you want, for PCs you want, with or without legend.  You can uses these data with the generic S3 plot function or the plot functions in e.g., ggplot2

Cheers!
Mike
